{{recipe}} 

== Ingredients ==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. boneless skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken#Breast|chicken breasts]]
* [[Cookbook:Poultry Shake|Poultry shake]]
* [[Cookbook:Cornmeal|Cornmeal]]
* Melted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 6 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. 1-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] buns, split in half
* 2 ½ [[Cookbook:Quart|quarts]] [[Cookbook:Peanut Oil|peanut oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] cut sides of buns with melted butter, and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Toast cut side down in a hot pan. Set aside.
#Coat chicken with melted butter. Season liberally with poultry shake and dredge in cornmeal. Let rest 2–3 minutes.
#Heat oil to 350°F. Add chicken breasts and [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]], 1 at a time, about 10 minutes. Drain on a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|cooling rack]].
#Cut chicken into portions that fit the buns. Place 1 chicken piece on each bottom half of a bun and top with the other half. Serve warm.

steps.text: Brush cut sides of buns with melted butter, and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Toast cut side down in a hot pan. Set aside.
Coat chicken with melted butter. Season liberally with poultry shake and dredge in cornmeal. Let rest 2–3 minutes.
Heat oil to 350°F. Add chicken breasts and fry, 1 at a time, about 10 minutes. Drain on a cooling rack.
Cut chicken into portions that fit the buns. Place 1 chicken piece on each bottom half of a bun and top with the other half. Serve warm.
